en.background: A prescribed uniform electric field exerts F=qE. Positive mass gives a=F/m.
en.objectives: Compare charge signs, field direction and acceleration.
en.equations: F = qE; a = qE/m; r = r₀ + v₀t + ½at²
en.setup: Choose a charge, mass, electric field and initial velocity.
en.instructions: Select a preset. Predict the force. Play, pause and save a baseline. Reverse charge and compare.
en.observations: Does acceleration change when speed changes? What reverses with negative charge?
en.expected: Constant vector acceleration; straight or parabolic trajectories.
en.misconceptions: Negative charge accelerates opposite E. Force does not point along velocity in general. Uniform prescribed fields ignore source geometry.
en.ask: Why does negative charge accelerate against the field?

zh-CN.background: 预设匀强电场产生电场力 F=qE，正质量粒子的加速度为 F/m。
zh-CN.objectives: 比较电荷正负、场方向与加速度。
zh-CN.equations: F = qE；a = qE/m；r = r₀ + v₀t + ½at²
zh-CN.setup: 设置电荷、质量、电场和初速度。
zh-CN.instructions: 选择预设，先预测受力，再播放、暂停和保存对照；改变电荷符号并比较。
zh-CN.observations: 速度增大时加速度会改变吗？负电荷会使什么反向？
zh-CN.expected: 加速度矢量恒定，轨迹可以是直线或抛物线。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 负电荷沿电场反向加速；受力方向不一定沿速度。均匀预设场忽略场源几何。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么负电荷沿电场反向加速？

en.background: Electric force is qE; magnetic force is q(v×B). Use the right-hand rule for positive q, reverse for negative q.
en.objectives: Relate sign, field and curvature; distinguish force from work.
en.equations: F = q(E + v × B); F_B · v = 0; r = mv/|qB| (E=0)
en.setup: Select Positive Magnetic and start with nonzero velocity.
en.instructions: Play and observe a circle. Reverse charge. Double B and compare radius. Then use crossed fields.
en.observations: Does magnetic-only speed change? Which way is the instantaneous acceleration?
en.expected: Magnetic-only motion conserves kinetic energy; electric fields can do work.
en.misconceptions: Magnetic force depends on velocity and is perpendicular to it. Right-hand direction applies to positive q. Lab-speed radius formula requires E=0.
en.ask: Why does magnetic force bend motion without changing speed?

zh-CN.background: 电场力为 qE，磁场力为 q(v×B)。正电荷用右手定则，负电荷反向。
zh-CN.objectives: 联系电荷、磁场和曲率，区分受力与做功。
zh-CN.equations: F = q(E + v × B)；F_B · v = 0；r = mv/|qB|（E=0）
zh-CN.setup: 选择正电荷磁场预设，使用非零初速度。
zh-CN.instructions: 播放观察圆轨迹，反转电荷，再把磁场加倍比较半径，最后观察交叉场。
zh-CN.observations: 纯磁场中速率改变吗？瞬时加速度指向哪里？
zh-CN.expected: 纯磁场保持动能；电场可以做功。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 磁场力依赖速度且垂直速度；右手定则方向适用于正电荷。使用实验室速率计算半径需 E=0。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么磁场使轨迹弯曲却不改变速率？

en.background: Prescribed piecewise-uniform fields superpose in overlaps. Local fields determine instantaneous Lorentz force.
en.objectives: Predict boundary transitions, overlap forces and continuity of position/velocity.
en.equations: E = Σ Eᵢ; B = Σ Bᵢ; F = q(E + v × B)
en.setup: Choose Electric then magnetic, or add rectangular regions. Initial position and velocity use SI units.
en.instructions: Edit exact dimensions or drag regions/handles. Apply changes. Fit all, play and inspect local fields. Ask AI for a reviewed edit.
en.observations: Which region IDs are active? Does acceleration change at an edge? Is speed constant in a magnetic-only zone?
en.expected: Position and velocity stay continuous; acceleration may jump at ideal boundaries. Zero field outside all enabled zones.
en.misconceptions: Overlaps add fields, not trajectories. Boundary discontinuities are idealized; no Maxwell solver or induced electric fields.
en.ask: Why does the particle curve after entering the magnetic region?

zh-CN.background: 预设分段均匀场在重叠区叠加，当前位置的局部场决定洛伦兹力。
zh-CN.objectives: 预测边界变化、叠加力以及位置和速度的连续性。
zh-CN.equations: E = Σ Eᵢ；B = Σ Bᵢ；F = q(E + v × B)
zh-CN.setup: 选择先电后磁预设，或添加矩形区域；初位置与初速度使用 SI 单位。
zh-CN.instructions: 输入精确尺寸或拖动区域和手柄，应用修改后适配视野、播放并检查局部场；AI 修改必须确认。
zh-CN.observations: 当前哪些区域生效？边缘处加速度改变吗？纯磁场区域速率恒定吗？
zh-CN.expected: 位置和速度连续，理想边界处加速度可跳变；所有区域外为零场。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 重叠时叠加场而非轨迹。理想边界不包含 Maxwell 求解或感生电场。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么粒子进入磁场区域后轨迹弯曲？

en.background: Coherent waves interfere; finite slit width supplies a diffraction envelope.
en.objectives: Relate wavelength, slit spacing and width to the profile and detection probability.
en.setup: Choose visible wavelength, separated finite slits and a far-field screen.
en.instructions: Choose a preset, predict the spacing, play to accumulate detections, then compare parameters.
en.observations: Does increasing separation narrow the fringes? What changes the envelope?
en.expected: Individual seeded events approximate the normalized intensity over the selected screen window.
en.misconceptions: A detection sample is prescribed probability, not a simulated quantum trajectory or measurement mechanism.
en.ask: Why does decreasing slit separation widen the fringes?

zh-CN.background: 相干波产生干涉，有限缝宽带来衍射包络。
zh-CN.objectives: 联系波长、缝间距、缝宽与强度分布、探测概率。
zh-CN.setup: 选择可见光波长、有限缝宽和满足远场条件的屏幕。
zh-CN.instructions: 选择预设，先预测条纹间距，再播放累积探测点并比较参数。
zh-CN.observations: 缝间距增大会使条纹变密吗？什么控制包络？
zh-CN.expected: 固定种子的探测点逐渐逼近所选屏幕窗口内归一化强度。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 这是给定概率分布的抽样，不是完整量子轨迹或测量过程模拟。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么缝间距减小时条纹变宽？

en.background: An inverse-square attractive force generates an ellipse in bound two-body relative motion.
en.objectives: Identify foci, compare equal-time areas and test T² against a³.
en.setup: Select mass, semimajor axis, eccentricity and initial mean anomaly.
en.instructions: Play, pause at apsides, show equal-time sectors and inspect the period comparison graph.
en.observations: Why does speed rise near periapsis? Are equal-time areas equal?
en.expected: Specific energy and angular momentum remain constant; period depends on a and total mass.
en.misconceptions: The central body is at a focus in this relative view, not at the geometric center or stationary in every inertial frame.
en.ask: Why does the orbiting body move faster near periapsis?

zh-CN.overview: 开普勒定律与二体运动
zh-CN.background: 反平方引力在有界二体相对运动中产生椭圆轨道。
zh-CN.objectives: 识别焦点、比较等时面积，并检验 T² 与 a³。
zh-CN.setup: 设置质量、半长轴、偏心率和初始平近点角。
zh-CN.instructions: 播放并在近远点暂停，显示等时扇区并检查周期比较图。
zh-CN.observations: 为什么近点运动更快？相等时间扫过的面积相等吗？
zh-CN.expected: 比机械能与比角动量保持恒定，周期由半长轴及总质量决定。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 相对坐标中中心天体位于焦点，不在几何中心，也不代表它在所有惯性系中静止。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么绕行天体在近点运动更快？

en.background: An isolated pair exchanges equal and opposite impulses at contact.
en.objectives: Compare elastic, inelastic and center-of-mass descriptions.
en.setup: Select a preset, positive masses, nonoverlapping disks and initial velocities.
en.instructions: Predict, play, seek the timeline or step forward; compare laboratory and center-of-mass charts.
en.observations: Does momentum stay constant? Which relative velocity component changes?
en.expected: Momentum is conserved; e=1 conserves kinetic energy, while e<1 dissipates normal relative kinetic energy.
en.misconceptions: For 2D frictionless disks, e=0 does not remove tangential relative motion or permanently glue them together.
en.ask: Why is momentum conserved while kinetic energy decreases?

zh-CN.background: 孤立的两个物体在接触时交换大小相等方向相反的冲量。
zh-CN.objectives: 比较弹性、非弹性碰撞及质心参考系。
zh-CN.equations: P=Σmv；K=Σ½m|v|²；法向相对速度(后)=−e×法向相对速度(前)
zh-CN.setup: 选择预设，设置正质量、互不重叠的圆盘和初始速度。
zh-CN.instructions: 先预测，再播放、拖动时间轴或单步前进，比较实验室系与质心系图表。
zh-CN.observations: 总动量是否恒定？相对速度的哪个分量改变？
zh-CN.expected: 动量守恒；e=1时动能守恒，e<1损失法向相对运动动能。
zh-CN.misconceptions: 二维无摩擦圆盘e=0并不消除切向相对运动，也不代表永久粘连。
zh-CN.ask: 为什么动量守恒而动能会减少？
